excerpt.zh:
星海帝国受到了致命的打击就此一蹶不振。由于其崩溃在即，我们现在可以恢复原有的星海共同体。

让这个互相沟通理解的平台取代掉独裁暴政吧！
excerpt.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been dealt a mortal blow from which it cannot recover. With its imminent collapse, we are now in a position to restore the old Galactic Community.

Let it serve as platform of diplomacy and mutual understanding instead of tyranny!
